title: Fix global text color so all in-app text renders green

requirements.text: Fix the Tailwind theme token values so the app’s default text color actually applies as green across the UI (all normal text that uses `text-foreground` / inherits from `body`). Update `frontend/src/index.css` CSS variables to match the format expected by `frontend/tailwind.config.js` (i.e., variables should be raw OKLCH components like `0.88 0.28 145`, not `oklch(...)`, because Tailwind already wraps them with `oklch(var(--...))`). Ensure both `:root` and `.dark` define `--foreground` (and related `*-foreground` variables used for typical text) as green so the user-visible text changes are clearly visible.

quotes: I meant to say the words letters data's In the app has to be green but there is no change

acceptanceCriteria: After rebuild, body text (inherited default text) renders green across the app screens (Hero, Header, tabs, forms, panels) without requiring per-component overrides.

`frontend/src/index.css` uses variable values compatible with `tailwind.config.js` (no nested `oklch(oklch(...))` patterns for theme tokens like `--foreground`, `--background`, `--card`, `--muted`, etc.).
In both light and dark modes, `text-foreground` results in green text that is visibly different from white/gray/black.
No changes are made to any frontend immutable paths (e.g., `frontend/src/main.tsx`, `frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts(x)`, `frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts`, `frontend/src/components/ui/*`).

requirements.text: Audit and update any non-immutable UI components that hardcode text colors (e.g., `text-black`, `text-white`, or other non-token colors) so that user-facing text follows the theme tokens (prefer `text-foreground`, `text-muted-foreground`, `text-primary`, etc.) and therefore renders green by default as requested.

quotes: the words letters data's In the app has to be green

acceptanceCriteria: Spot-check: Header brand text, tab labels, panel titles, form labels/inputs, tables, and recommendation text all appear green (or green-tinted via theme tokens) rather than default black/white.
Any explicit text color utility classes that prevent the global green text from showing are removed/replaced in non-immutable components.

constraints: Frontend must remain React + TypeScript + Tailwind + React Query.
Do not edit files under `frontend/src/components/ui` (shadcn UI sources) or any paths listed in `frontend.immutablePaths`.
Backend is out of scope unless required for text rendering (it should not be required for this request).
nonGoals: Adding new app features unrelated to text color.
Introducing new theming systems beyond the existing Tailwind CSS variable-token approach.
